# CWE-798: Mailgun key — key- prefix with 32 alnum.
# key- 32 chars is a Mailgun secret; leaked keys can send mail.
# ruleid: detected-mailgun-api-key
key-abcDEF1234567890abcDEF1234567890
# ruleid: detected-mailgun-api-key
mailgun_key: key-0123456789abcdef0123456789ABCDEF12
# ok: detected-mailgun-api-key
key-short
# ok: detected-mailgun-api-key
not-a-token
# ruleid: detected-mailgun-api-key
key-CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC
# ruleid: detected-mailgun-api-key
mailgun: key-DDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDD
# ok: detected-mailgun-api-key
mailgun_key = "example_key_placeholder"
